subject: maths
question:
The following pie chart describes sales of a particular brand of T-shirts in 6 of their outlets P, Q, R, S, T, and U.

The total sales in which two given outlets exceed the sales in outlet S?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9ab1c9e9b0b610fe96d2bbff8f9f9447c06ed508529dc35da2c3fa8a1878d682.png]
solution:
**Given:**

Sale in Outlet S = 26%

**Calculation:**

According to the question, 

From the options:

Option A,

⇒ P + Q = 14% + 10% = 24%

It is not more than S.

option B,

⇒ R + U = 18% + 12% = 30%

It is more than S 

**∴ Option B is the correct answer.**
